exposure: admission to a special care or neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 1000 Australian fathers recruited during the antenatal period via their pregnant partner
finding: Fathers of preterm infants were significantly more likely to meet the case criteria for anxiety six weeks after birth compared to fathers of term babies.
mod_finding: Fathers of preterm infants experienced significantly more anxiety and lower quality of life six weeks after birth compared to fathers of term infants.
birth_weight: Low birth weight mentioned as a characteristic of preterm infants
